body: For anyone still wondering, a reference to the map is passed in the events from [builtInMarker](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/geo-search/js/#widget-param-builtinmarker) and [customHTMLMarker](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/geo-search/js/#widget-param-customhtmlmarker).
